data.title: The Hidden Costs of Delegating to AI
data.description: AI can dramatically accelerate individual tasks without delivering equivalent gains for the organization, because delegating work creates costs beyond execution. Evidence from four accounting firms shows how faster tax preparation can shift bottlenecks to review, undermine employee incentives, and disrupt the development of future professionals. To turn time savings into lasting value, leaders must assess the full costs of delegation, redesign workflows and roles, and decide how to use the capacity AI creates.
